description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {4}{R}, creating a token copies of it plus a Food artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Improvised Arsenal token and the Food token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Crime Novelist triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
